raw_response:
I sit down to think about this year's planting. At 71 I've seen many seasons, and my hands know this soil well. With only my husband and me at home now, I need to be careful — we can't work like we used to, and every yuan for fertilizer comes out of our pocket.

My 12 mu — I keep about 10 mu in the wheat-maize rotation like everyone here does, and I still keep 2 mu in cotton on the sandier piece by the road. Cotton prices aren't what they were, but I've grown it for forty years and I know how to handle it.

**Winter wheat (10 mu):** I'll use Jimai or Shixin improved seed, same as last year — my neighbor Old Wang got 480 kg/mu and I did about the same. Before sowing I spread about 50 kg of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) per mu as base, then topdress with 15 kg urea at greening-up. That gives me roughly 18 kg N, 7.5 kg P, 7.5 kg K per mu. I irrigate before winter (dongshui), at greening, at jointing, and at grain-filling — 4 times with the well. Two sprays: one for aphids and powdery mildew at heading, one combined herbicide earlier. Rotary tillage before sowing.

**Summer maize (10 mu):** Straight after wheat harvest, no-till direct seeding — saves diesel and my back. Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu hybrid, these work here. About 40 kg compound (15-15-15) at sowing, then 20 kg urea at big trumpet stage. That's around 20 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. One irrigation if July is dry, usually rain is enough. One spray for corn borer. I expect 550 kg/mu, that's what my field gives.

**Cotton (2 mu):** Improved Bt variety for bollworm — I stopped spraying so much after switching to Bt twenty years ago. I plough this plot, cotton likes loose soil. About 15 kg urea plus 30 kg compound per mu, so 17 kg N, 5 kg P, 5 kg K. Topdress another 10 kg urea at flowering. Irrigate 3 times — pre-planting, bud stage, boll stage. Still need 5 sprays for aphids, spider mites, and lygus bugs even with Bt. Expect 230 kg/mu seed cotton.
